_comment: Canonical fixtures for <NNN> — <Feature name>. Replace this object with the scenario array the tests and seeders load. Use ONE definition only: either this JSON is loaded by test helpers/seeders, or the code fixture is canonical and the brief points to it — never two hand-written copies. Fixtures must include: the happy-path scenario, cross-tenant users, unauthorized matter users, restricted documents, stale versions, failed integrations, and malformed inputs where relevant. All data is synthetic — never real client names, real case numbers, or privileged text.
